# Mohammad Moin

> Senior Web & Mobile Application Developer and corporate trainer with 14+ years across React, Angular, Vue, and Node.js. Remote-based in Bengaluru, India (IST, UTC+5:30), open to cross-timezone teams.

## About
Mohammad Moin works at the intersection of building and teaching. As a developer, he designs and ships production web and mobile applications end to end — architecture through deployment. As a freelance corporate trainer, he has trained 15,000+ engineers across 350+ sessions for enterprise teams at IBM, Amazon, Walmart, SAP, and Dell.

## Development
- Frontend & Mobile: React, Angular, Vue.js, Next.js, SolidJS, React Native, TypeScript
- Backend & APIs: Node.js, NestJS, Express, GraphQL
- Infra & Tooling: AWS, Firebase, Docker, GitHub Actions

## Recent engagement
React Consultant, JLL (Jan 2024 – Mar 2025): re-architected legacy AEM/Java-based web components to React within a 10–15 engineer team spanning multiple countries; orchestrated a shared design system built in SolidJS, translated into React and Angular.

## Selected projects
- AquaTrack — water consumption and billing platform deployed for a residential society (React, TypeScript, Firebase)
- Freelance Billing & Taxation Tool — independent invoicing/billing system handling Indian GST and statutory compliance
- Giftiicon — e-commerce gifting app (React Native, Node.js)

## Training
- React & NestJS Intermediate Track — 40-hour curriculum, API-first sequencing
- GenAI-Powered .NET Application Development — core-concepts reference course (prompt engineering, Azure OpenAI, RAG, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP, agent architecture)
- Enterprise clients: IBM, Amazon, Walmart, SAP, Dell — cohorts of 20–50 engineers (5+ years' experience each), with repeat engagements from returning clients
